lines: This way. What's wrong? Come quickly. First time in a brothel?
That's not it. I just thought you were going to show me the way to Chaos Arena?
Led by Zocht, we had arrived at a high-class brothel overflowing with obscene light and laughter.
Don't panic. The Chaos Arena is below here.
Below a place like this? Really?
Are you still doubting me? If I had wanted to set you up, I would've done it ages ago, bro.
I guess that's true. Alright, I'll believe you, old dude.
Okay, it felt like the timing was right. I used the communication device I had been hiding. And in response to the signalー
A heavy sound cut through the air and the guards at the entrance where thrown to the side.
The alarm rang loudly and the brothel erupted into chaos. Even as more guards jumped out, Hotaru-senpai mowed them down one by one.
H-Hey!? What do you think you're doing!?
Chaos Arena is down below, right? That means we don't need you to show us the way anymore.
Fucking brat!! Think you're hot shit, huh, well don't go thinking you'll get away with this!!
Oh? Didn't you like quick-witted youngsters like me?
Hotaru struck the furious Zocht directly in the head with her battle axe and Zocht collapsed to the ground in agony.
Playing it cool is fine and all, but anticipate the counterattack.
H-Hey, Fuma... We made quite a scene here, will Hebiko be alright?!
The enemy didn't attack me in the back alley and also didn't cut me off from my allies, who one would naturally think would be around.
So I'm pretty sure they had already taken into consideration the fact that I would force my way in.
If we go, it'll become clear. And since we don't know what their goal is, we have no choice but to accept the invitation.
I guess that's true... In that case let's quickly go and rescue Hebiko!
Not as reliable as you are, Hotaru-senpai...
I was sincerely grateful to Hotaru-senpai for securing the floor in mere minutes, like a bulldozer.
Anyway, let's go. Hebiko-chan is waiting for us.
Ugh... haah... haah... Hebiko somehow managed... to defeat them...
In front of Hebiko, whose entire body was covered in wounds, the powerful enemy Trolls lay scattered about, their dark blood flowing out.
But Hebiko once again was so exhausted that it took all she had to support her own body.
However the cruel show wasn't over yet. The announcer cold-heartedly announced the entrance of the next adversaries.
The next opponents for the bravely fighting Miss Hebiko are the demonic beasts you know so well, the Salamanders!!!
What entered the arena were bizarre-looking warriors, kind like a snake and a lizard. They were most likely monsters from the Devildom.
Hebiko-chan! Show us what you got!!!
S-So this won't end until Hebiko loses...
But at least she couldn't say that they were underestimating the stamina of an octopus.
(Fuma-chan, Hebiko might not be able to become a bride...)
There was no choice but to keep fighting. With the lustful cheers of the crowd behind her, Hebiko's fight to the death continued.
